key.name: dock-folders
key.description: Keys of the folders shown in the dock. App Grid folders use their folder ID, custom folders start with "custom:". Keys that no longer exist are skipped.

key.name: custom-folders
key.description: JSON list of folders made in the preferences, each with an id, a name and a list of app IDs.

key.name: folder-anchors
key.summary: Where each folder sits in the dock
key.description: Maps a folder key to the pinned app it comes after. An empty value puts the folder first. Folders without an entry go at the end of the dock.

key.name: show-separator
key.description: Draw a separator line before the folders that sit at the end of the dock.

key.name: popup-columns
key.description: How many apps are shown per row when a folder is opened.

key.name: hide-favorites
key.summary: Hide favorite apps inside App Grid folders
key.description: Like the App Grid, leave out apps that are already pinned to the Dash. Custom folders always show every app they contain.
